title: Home
description: M&M Bakery & Deli — Kansas City's family-owned bakery and deli on 31st Street since 1962.

blocks.heading: Home of the Hook Em' Up Sandwich
blocks.subheading: Family-owned on 31st Street since 1962 — fresh bread, hand-stacked sandwiches, and the kind of deli where everybody's a regular.

items.title: Hook 'Em Up
items.desc: Turkey, ham, and pastrami on an onion roll with mustard, miracle whip, lettuce, tomato, pickles, onions, hot and American cheeses.

items.title: Reuben
items.desc: Corned beef on rye bread, sauerkraut, pickle, onion, thousand island dressing, and Swiss cheese.

items.title: C.E.O.
items.desc: Turkey ham, pastrami, turkey breast, and beef salami on a steak bun with a full toppings bar and five cheeses.

items.title: Build Your Own
items.desc: Your choice of any toppings, two meats, and two cheeses. Includes small chips.

items.title: Breakfast Sandwich
items.desc: Your choice of one meat with Swiss or American cheese and one egg. Served 7:30–10:30am.

items.title: Fresh Cookies
items.desc: M&M, chocolate chip, peanut butter, snickerdoodle, sugar, oatmeal raisin — baked daily.

items.text: My sandwich was delicious. Someone saw me eating it and had to know where I got it.
The staff are very cordial and professional.
The fresh food... It's like a home. You keep coming back.

blocks.heading: Craving the Hook 'Em Up?
blocks.text: Call ahead or walk in — Kansas City's bakery and deli since 1962.
